name: Castrol India Ltd
title: Castrol India Ltd - 500870 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY26 revenue +9% to INR1,545 cr, EBITDA +7% to INR329 cr, but management flagged raw-material and FX costs flowing into Q2 with only one price round taken; margin guidance of 21-24% kept.

triggers.label: One price round taken end-March
triggers.quote: We have taken one round of pricing already end of March.

triggers.label: Raw-material cost hit deferred to Q2
triggers.quote: the majority of the cost increases that we are talking about, we are now pending 2Q.

triggers.label: Volume +7-8% YoY in Q1
triggers.quote: 7% to 8% volume growth is what we have delivered for the quarter.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin band 21-24% reiterated
triggers.quote: we will want to go back into that same range of 21%, 24%.

guidance.quote: we will want to go back into that same range of 21%, 24%.

red_flags.label: Opex up ~23% QoQ, 'one-time' employee costs unquantified
red_flags.quote: the one-time costs that I spoke about are more in the employee cost bucket

red_flags.label: Q1 gross cost lag; margin dilution expected from Q2
red_flags.quote: 2Q onwards, even the raw material prices will start showing up.

evasions.quote: So, I won't be able to specifically answer your price increase percentage question
We can't make a guidance at the moment because this is not something we are driving
There have been some one-time costs here, but structurally
